verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. God really is good to Israel, to those whose hearts are pure.
But as for me, I almost lost my footing. My feet nearly slipped.
I was jealous of proud people when I saw how well the wicked were doing.
They do not struggle when they die. Their bodies are healthy and strong.
They do not have the troubles other people have. They are not struck by problems like everyone else.
So they wear pride like a necklace. They wrap themselves in violence like clothing.
Their eyes bulge out from their fat faces. Their minds are full of proud ideas.
They make fun of others and speak with hatred. In their pride they threaten to crush people.
They speak as if they rule the skies. Their tongues strut across the earth.
So people turn to them and drink in everything they say.
They say, "How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?"
Look, this is what the wicked are like. They always have an easy life, and their riches keep growing.
It seems I have kept my heart pure for nothing. I have washed my hands to show I am innocent, but for nothing.
All day long I have trouble. Every morning brings me new punishment.
If I had said, "I will talk like this," I would have betrayed your children.
When I tried to understand all this, it was too hard for me,
until I went into God's holy place. Then I understood what will happen to the wicked in the end.
You put them on slippery ground. You throw them down to ruin.
How suddenly they are destroyed! They are completely swept away by terrors.
They are like a dream that disappears when a person wakes up. Lord, when you get up, you will brush them aside like a dream.
When my heart was bitter and my feelings were hurt,
I was foolish and did not understand. I was like an animal in front of you.
Yet I am always with you. You hold my right hand.
You guide me with your advice, and afterward you will take me into glory.
Who do I have in heaven but you? There is nothing on earth I want more than you.
My body and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart. He is mine forever.
Those who are far from you will be destroyed. You destroy everyone who is unfaithful to you.
But for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Lord GOD my safe place, so I can tell about everything you have done.
